name: C/C++ (MSVC Build Tools)
description: MSVC Build Tools estable de Microsoft con Desktop development with C++, instalado y actualizado mediante winget.

command.windows: if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'winget no está disponible; usa packwire install msvc --mode site para abrir Microsoft.' } else { winget install --id Microsoft.VisualStudio.BuildTools -e --source winget --override '--wait --passive --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --includeRecommended --norestart' --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { winget upgrade --id Microsoft.VisualStudio.BuildTools -e --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements } }
